name: The Ancient Courts
description: The seat of Pashupati Chakravarthy's pre-Jharwa court, whose precise location is unresolved. Varunesh's Shadow Pact was performed at the Dwarka Gate; the pact's consequences reached the ancient courts.
notes: Named only by `event_shadow_pact`, which records both the summoning of Manjalaya through a Dwarka Gate and `curse_on_ancient_courts` among its outcomes. Canon does not place it, and does not say whether the curse ever lifted.
